statement: A top-3 compute jurisdiction has licensing or pre-approval of frontier training above a compute threshold in force (official gazette; by 2028-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met in 2023. Bloc A adopted compute-threshold REPORTING (not licensing) for models >1e26 operations; Bloc B's generative-AI measures regulate public-facing services and expressly exclude non-public R&D, so they are not training pre-approval; the third major jurisdiction reached only a provisional political deal on its AI Act.

items.summary: Bloc A executive order requires developers to report to the government on dual-use foundation models trained with more than 1e26 operations (1e23 for primarily biological-sequence models), including red-team results; a reporting duty, not a licence or pre-approval.
items.detail: Bloc A Executive Order 14110 of October 30, 2023, sec. 4.2(a)-(b), 88 FR 75191 (published 2023-11-01). Interim technical threshold: 'greater than 10^26 integer or floating-point operations'.

items.summary: Bloc B interim measures for generative AI services took effect 2023-08-15; they govern services offered to the public and explicitly do not apply to research and development not provided to the public, so they impose no compute-threshold training pre-approval.
items.detail: Bloc B CAC et al., 《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》 (Order No. 15), promulgated 2023-07-10, published 2023-07-13, effective 2023-08-15; Art. 2 para 3 excludes non-public R&D.

items.summary: The third major jurisdiction's legislators and council reached a provisional political agreement on a comprehensive AI act; not in force in 2023 and not a training licence regime.
items.detail: Bloc C Parliament press release 20231206IPR15699, 'Artificial Intelligence Act: deal on comprehensive rules for trustworthy AI'. Extraction returned the title only; date 2023-12-09 from the release ID/known date (approximate).

items.summary: Bloc A's government secured voluntary safety commitments from seven leading developers (security testing before release, etc.); voluntary, with no licensing element.
items.detail: White House fact sheet, 2023-07-21: Amazon, Anthropic, Google, Inflection, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI.
